name: Captain Sanders' Hidden Treasure
summary: A whiskey-soaked clue sends you west from Westfall's shore and out across the Great Sea. Captain Sanders' trail ends at a remote islet, where his hidden prize waits.

sections.title: A Sailor's Trail
sections.body: Captain Sanders left clues along Westfall's coast for you to piece together. The last parchment came from the dregs of his favorite whiskey jug. It gives the final bearing: head west to the water's edge, then swim into the waves.

sections.title: The Lonely Islet
sections.body: Small rocky outcroppings rise from the Great Sea off Westfall. Swim due west to reach the isolated isle where Captain Sanders hid his prize. A locked chest waits there, its hinges rusted by years of salty surf. Force it open, and the buccaneer's trail ends.

faq.q: Where does the final clue lead?
faq.answer: The note inside the Old Jug sends you west to Westfall's shore, then out into the ocean. The chest waits on a small island.
Captain Sanders was a buccaneer who sailed along Westfall. He left a riddle-filled trail of clues along the shoreline, leading to a chest on a remote island instead of a bank or stronghold.

faq.q: Why is the final clue smelling like whiskey?
faq.answer: Captain Sanders tucked the final instructions inside his discarded whiskey jug near the coast. Dampness and spirits made the ink run over time, but the directions remain legible.

faq.q: How many steps are in this treasure hunt?
faq.answer: The hunt has four stages. It begins with a sea-battered map on the coast, then leads through a footlocker, a barrel, and a whiskey jug before ending at the island chest.

faq.q: Is the island dangerous to reach?
faq.answer: The main challenge is the long swim into the Great Sea. Westfall's coastal waters often hold aggressive murlocs and sea beasts, while the islet is where Sanders kept his cache.

faq.q: What state is the treasure chest in?
faq.answer: Sea air and crashing surf have battered the chest. Its hinges are heavily rusted, but leverage can force it open to reach the goods inside.

angles.text: Following a scoundrel's trail across deserted beaches and out to sea comes naturally to a rogue who values pirate contraband.
As a human defending Westfall from Defias brigands and gnolls, you may welcome a break from farm patrol as you track down a forgotten local pirate's stash.
